summary: An elongated Moval centre stone in a full 14K yellow gold bezel, with delicate vintage details and a substantial 2 mm polished band.
description:
A vintage-inspired design with an elongated Moval centre stone, combining the soft curves of an oval with the long silhouette of a marquise. A full yellow gold bezel surrounds the stone, with delicate beaded detailing and diamond accents at the shoulders.

The 2 mm band has a slightly heavier gold presence and finishes in a plain polished band at the back. The supplied images show a 3 ct centre.

Starting prices: 3 ct from $4,900 CAD; 4 ct from $5,900 CAD; 5 ct from $7,200 CAD. Diamond origin, quality, exact measurements and final pricing are confirmed with the selected stone. Carat weight and final appearance may vary slightly; pricing depends on stone quality, availability and custom modifications.
